units: <cite ref="Makkot 23b:16">Macc. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>בלשון י׳</he> in the singular number, opp. <he>ל׳ רבים</he>.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 20a:8">Kidd. 20ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>בגפו</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 21:3">Ex. XXI, 3</cite>) <he>י׳ נכנס וכ׳</he> single (unmarried) he entered &c.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:4">Ab. III, 4</cite> <he>המהלך בדרך י׳</he> who travels alone.
Ib. IV, 8 אל תהי דן י׳ וכ׳ do not hold court as a single judge, for there is only One who judges singly; a. fr.—Fem. יְחִידִית.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 2:8:2">Y. Kil. II, 28ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>גפן י׳</he> a single (isolated) vine tree.
Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵃ top מצבה כל שהיא י׳ it is called matsebah when consisting of one piece (v. בִּימוּס); a. e.—Pl. יְחִידִיּוֹת.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 5:1:3">Y. Kil. V, beg. 29ᵈ</cite> <he>בי׳</he> in the case of isolated vine trees.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:2:3">Y. Sot. IX, 23ᶜ</cite> top <he>י׳</he> isolated tombstones.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 6:2">Esth. R. to II, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="J00125"><he>יְהוּדִי</he></cite>.
